newsitem.title: USA: Sen. D'Amato sees bank hearings in 4-5 weeks.
newsitem.headline: Sen. D'Amato sees bank hearings in 4-5 weeks.

text.p: Senate Banking Committee Chairman Alfonse D'Amato said Wednesday he expects to introduce a bill to reform the U.S. financial services sector soon and expects to hold hearings on the issue in four or five weeks.

"We'll be introducing something sooner rather than later," the New York Republican said after a speech at the Government Finance Officers Association meeting here. "Hopefully we'll be able to work with the Treasury Department."
D'Amato said his bill would be a comprehensive overhaul of the Glass-Steagall act, the law which separates banking from other financial services.
D'Amato said regulatory relief in finance is "long overdue." Although legislation has failed in the past "I think we can do that," he said.
But with several proposals already on the table "it's going to be contentious," D'Amato said.
